title: Add Spike-Twin runner and epochal trace aggregator for paired-microburst analysis
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: We frequently see paired microburst patterns in customer workloads (short spike, short quiet, second spike) that standard single-burst profilers miss. This PR adds a new workload runner (Spike-Twin) that synthesizes paired-spike sessions with configurable separation and jitter, plus an epochal trace exporter/aggregator that builds per-epoch kernel-level flame profiles and emits anchored traces for downstream anomaly detection. The goal is to provide a representative runner for paired-burst scenarios and a reporting pipeline that makes cross-run comparisons simple. What this change includes: 1) spike-twin runner implemented in Go with sequence primer support, session jitter and warmup modes; 2) epochal-flame-aggregator Python pipeline that ingests raw perf traces, aligns them into fixed-length epochs, computes per-kernel token cost and p99 latencies, and generates a compact flame snapshot for each epoch; 3) new fixture profiles and a deterministic RNG seed option to make CI runs reproducible; 4) integration tests that validate alignment across noisy runs and check for regression in per-epoch tail latency; 5) docs and a short how-to for adding new paired-burst profiles. Checklist: [x] Runner implementation and unit tests, [x] Aggregator pipeline and unit tests, [x] Integration tests in e2e/paired_spike_test.go, [x] Docs added under docs/perf/spike-twin.md, [x] CI workflow updated to include lightweight smoke runs. Commits (summary): - 9f4d2c1: initial spike-twin runner scaffold and API surface - b61e8a3: add session generator, primer support, RNG seed flag - e3a7b24: epochal-flame-aggregator initial ingest/align/emit flow - 2c54f96: add fixtures and deterministic profiles - c8b2a1e: integration test + CI workflow change - f1a9d77: address reviewer feedback (tagging conventions, CLI help) Files changed (high level): - benchmark-lab/runners/spike_twin/runner.go (new): core runner loop, primer apply, jitter model - benchmark-lab/reporters/epochal_aggregator/aggregate.py (new): ingest raw traces, epoch alignment, compute kernel stats - benchmark-lab/reporters/epochal_aggregator/flame_serializer.py (new): compact flame snapshot format and serializer - benchmark-lab/fixtures/paired_spike_profiles.yaml (new): declarative profiles for spike spacing/amplitude - benchmark-lab/e2e/paired_spike_test.go (new): deterministic integration test using fixtures - docs/perf/spike-twin.md (new): design notes, how-to, expected signal shapes - .github/workflows/benchmark-smoke.yml (modified): add smoke job that runs the new runner with small profiles
